title: corypha humilis
intro: Corypha humilis, commonly known as the dwarf palmyra or dwarf palmtree, is a species of palm tree native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Corypha humilis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
